nodes.summary: The closed upper half-plane `{z : 0 ≤ Im z}`.
nodes.title: Closed upper half-plane

nodes.summary: The complement of a compact `ℍ`-hull is connected.
nodes.title: Complement of a compact hull is connected

nodes.summary: `g` is hydrodynamically normalized at infinity with half-plane capacity `a`: `g(z) - z → 0` and `z (g(z) - z) → a` as `z → ∞`, i.e. `g(z) = z + a/z + o(1/z)`.
nodes.title: Hydrodynamic normalization with half-plane capacity

nodes.summary: The Loewner trajectory from `z` extends in `ℍ` beyond time `t`. This is the intrinsic maximal-lifetime condition used to determine the unswallowed domain.
nodes.title: Forward extension of a Loewner trajectory

nodes.summary: `(D, g)` is chordal SLE`_κ` in `ℍ` from `0` to `∞`: `κ ≥ 0`, `B` is a standard Brownian motion and almost surely `g` solves the maximal Loewner equation with driving function `√κ B`. This is a definition only; existence of SLE is not proved.
nodes.title: Chordal Schramm–Loewner evolution

nodes.summary: A compact `ℍ`-hull: a bounded subset `K` of `ℍ`, relatively closed in `ℍ`, whose complement `ℍ \ K` is open and simply connected.
nodes.title: Compact hull in the upper half-plane

nodes.summary: `t ↦ g_t(z)` satisfies the Loewner equation `∂_t g_t(z) = 2 / (g_t(z) - W_t)` at time `t`.
nodes.title: Solution of the Loewner equation at a time

nodes.summary: `t ↦ g_t(z)` satisfies the Loewner equation on `s` (derivatives within `s`).
nodes.title: Solution of the Loewner equation on a set of times

nodes.summary: The complex upper half-plane is simply connected.
nodes.title: The upper half-plane is simply connected

nodes.summary: A standard real Brownian motion indexed by `ℝ` (used for `t ≥ 0`): `B_0 = 0` a.s., continuous paths a.s., Gaussian, with independent increments `B_t - B_s ~ N(0, t - s)`.
nodes.title: Standard real Brownian motion

nodes.summary: The chordal Loewner vector field `w ↦ 2 / (w - W_t)` at time `t`.
nodes.title: Chordal Loewner vector field

nodes.summary: The real axis `{z : Im z = 0}` in `ℂ`.
nodes.title: Real axis in the complex plane

nodes.summary: `g_0 = id` and `t ↦ g_t(z)` solves the Loewner equation for every `z ∈ ℂ` and every `t ≥ 0`, with no domain restriction (compare `SatisfiesMaximalLoewnerEquation`, where `z` ranges over the unswallowed domain `D_t`).
nodes.title: Loewner equation without domain restriction

nodes.summary: The maximal chordal Loewner evolution with domains `D_t`. The domains are exactly the points whose trajectories extend beyond `t`, and `g_t : D_t → ℍ` is a conformal bijection.
nodes.title: Maximal chordal Loewner evolution

can_prove.label: ready to prove

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
